import { useMessage } from '@src/utils/useMessage';
import { CONFIRM_KEYWORD, EMPTY_STRING, FIRST_ARG_INDEX, MIN_SKILL_BOOK_INDEX, SECOND_ARG_INDEX, SKILL_TYPE_MAP } from '@src/constants';
import App from '@src/response-apps/skillBook/switch/app';
import { selects } from '@src/response/config';
import type { SkillBookSwitchOption } from '@src/api/schemas/skill-book-switch-options';
import { addOptions, FormatGui } from '@src/utils/messageHelper';
import { withBackendRepeatDetection } from '@src/utils/backendRepeatDetector';
import { createBackendRequestContext } from '@src/api/bot/context';
import { Format, onResponse } from 'alemonjs';
/**
 * 展示已学习的对应类型技能列表，供玩家点击选择切换（纯渲染）
 */
const renderSkillSelectionList = (
  message: any,
  isPrivate: boolean,
  bid: string,
  _uid: number,
  typeSkillBooks: SkillBookSwitchOption[],
  skillTypeName: string
) => {
  const contentMd = Format.createMarkdown();

  contentMd.addBlockquote(Format.createMarkdown().addText('点击 [切换] 可直接装备对应功法'));

  // 先显示使用中的功法
  const inUse = typeSkillBooks.filter(sb => sb.isInUse);
  const notInUse = typeSkillBooks.filter(sb => sb.canSwitch);

  if (inUse.length > 0) {
    contentMd.addText('【使用中】');
    contentMd.addNewline();

    for (const sb of inUse) {
      contentMd.addText(`⚡【${sb.name}】（ID：${sb.id}）`);
      contentMd.addNewline();
    }

    contentMd.addNewline();
  }

  if (notInUse.length > 0) {
    contentMd.addText('【可切换】');
    contentMd.addNewline();

    for (const sb of notInUse) {
      contentMd.addText(`${sb.name}（ID：${sb.id}）`);

      addOptions(contentMd, [{ label: '切换', command: `/切换${skillTypeName} ${sb.id}` }]);
    }

    contentMd.addNewline();
  }

  void message.send(
    FormatGui({
      isPrivate,
      bid,
      title: `切换${skillTypeName}`,
      header: [{ label: '返回', command: '/我的功法' }],
      content: contentMd
    })
  );
};

/**
 * 创建切换功法指令处理器
 * @param skillTypeName 技能类型名称（战技、被动技、神通）
 * 指令格式: /切换{类型} [功法ID]
 * 不带ID时展示已学习的对应类型功法列表供选择
 */
const createSwitchHandler = (skillTypeName: string) => {
  return onResponse(selects, async e => {
    const [message] = useMessage();
    const bid = e?.UserId;
    const isPrivate = e.isPrivate ?? false;

    const uid = e.uid as number;

    // 解析命令参数（移除命令前缀）
    const commandPattern = new RegExp(`^(!|！|/|#|＃)?切换${skillTypeName}\\s*`, 'g');
    const messageText = (e.MessageText || EMPTY_STRING).replace(commandPattern, EMPTY_STRING).trim();
    const args = messageText ? messageText.split(/\s+/) : [];
    const skillBookIdStr = args[FIRST_ARG_INDEX];
    const confirmArg = args[SECOND_ARG_INDEX];

    // 解析 skillBookId（无 ID 或格式无效时传 undefined）
    let skillBookId: number | undefined;

    if (skillBookIdStr && skillBookIdStr !== EMPTY_STRING) {
      const parsed = parseInt(skillBookIdStr, 10);

      if (!isNaN(parsed) && parsed >= MIN_SKILL_BOOK_INDEX) {
        skillBookId = parsed;
      }
    }

    const forceSwitch = confirmArg === CONFIRM_KEYWORD;

    // 调用数据层
    const result = await App({
      messageText: e.MessageText,
      bid,
      uid,
      skillBookId,
      skillTypeName: skillTypeName as SkillBookSwitchOption['skillType'],
      forceSwitch,
      request: createBackendRequestContext(e)
    });

    switch (result.code) {
      case 'NO_SKILL_BOOKS': {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText(`❌ ${result.data.message}`);
        md.addNewline();
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText('💡请先通过 /学习功法 学习对应类型的功法');

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

        return;
      }

      case 'SHOW_LIST': {
        void renderSkillSelectionList(message, isPrivate, bid, uid, result.data.typeSkillBooks, result.data.skillTypeName);

        return;
      }

      case 'FAILED': {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        const displayMsg = await withBackendRepeatDetection(bid, uid, e.MessageText, result.data.message, createBackendRequestContext(e));

        md.addText('❌ 切换失败');
        md.addNewline();
        md.addNewline();
        md.addText(displayMsg);

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

        return;
      }

      case 'NEED_CONFIRM': {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText(`⚠️ ${result.data.message}`);
        md.addNewline();

        void message.send(
          FormatGui({
            isPrivate,
            bid,
            title: '',
            content: md,
            footer: [{ label: '确认切换', command: `/切换${skillTypeName} ${result.data.actualSkillBookId} 确认` }]
          })
        );

        return;
      }

      case 'LOAD_FAILED': {
        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText(result.data.message);

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md }));

        return;
      }

      case 'OK': {
        const { result: switchResult } = result.data;

        // 构建成功消息
        let successMessage = `✅ 切换成功\n\n【${switchResult.skillBook?.name}】\n类型: ${switchResult.skillBook?.skillType}`;

        // 如果替换了旧功法
        if (switchResult.oldSkillBook) {
          successMessage += `\n\n已将【${switchResult.oldSkillBook.name}】切换为已学习状态`;
        }

        successMessage += '\n\n💡可通过 /我的功法 查看功法状态';

        const md = Format.createMarkdown();

        md.addText(successMessage);

        md.addNewline();

        void message.send(FormatGui({ isPrivate, bid, title: '', content: md, footer: [{ label: '查看我的功法', command: '/我的功法' }] }));
      }
    }
  });
};

// 导出三种类型的切换处理器
export const switchBattleSkill = createSwitchHandler(SKILL_TYPE_MAP['战技']);
export const switchPassiveSkill = createSwitchHandler(SKILL_TYPE_MAP['被动技']);
export const switchMysticSkill = createSwitchHandler(SKILL_TYPE_MAP['神通']);

// 默认导出战技切换处理器
export default switchBattleSkill;
